text: dsh-memory-vault 是为 DSH Web 客户端提供跨会话记忆的插件。它把记忆条目保存在 dsh_memory 存储域中，注册 memory_remember、memory_recall 和 memory_forget 三个模型工具，并将最近条目加入每轮系统提示。用户可以记下事实、偏好、决定和项目笔记，之后按关键词或标签检索，也可按 ID 或标签删除。设置页还支持浏览、快速添加和删除记忆。适合希望 Agent 在新会话中延续项目背景与用户偏好的 DSH 用户；需在配置中接入存储、工具、系统提示及可选的 Web 服务。

dsh-memory-vault gives DSH agents persistent memory across sessions. It stores notes, offers tools to save, search, and delete them, and injects recent entries into each system prompt. A Settings page supports memory management. It suits users who want DSH to retain project facts and preferences.
想让 DSH Agent 在新会话里记得之前的项目约定
怎样把用户偏好保存下来供后续对话使用？
需要一个能按关键词找回旧笔记的 DSH 记忆功能
让 DSH 每轮提示自动带上最近保存的事实
DSH 忘了上次讨论的决定，能不能跨会话找回来
我想按标签整理并删除过时的 Agent 记忆
How can my DSH agent remember project facts across sessions?
I need to search saved preferences and decisions by keywords
Can DSH inject recent notes into each system prompt?
I want a settings page to browse and manage persistent agent memories
dsh-memory-vault 的功能「记忆工具」：memory_remember 保存带可选标签的事实或偏好，memory_recall 按关键词和标签匹配查找，memory_forget 按 ID 或标签删除条目。
dsh-memory-vault 的功能「逐轮提示注入」：插件在系统提示中加入最近更新的记忆条目，数量由 injectLimit 控制；没有记忆时不添加该段内容。
dsh-memory-vault 的功能「网页管理页」：DSH 设置中的“记忆库”页面列出条目，提供快速添加和删除按钮，并通过同源 JSON 路由读写记忆。
dsh-memory-vault 的功能「注入与检索条数配置」：部署配置可设置 injectLimit 控制每轮提示注入条数，并设置 recallLimit 限制 memory_recall 返回条数；两项都有默认值和范围校验。

dsh-memory-vault 提供工具 memory_remember：Persist one fact, user preference, decision, convention, or project note to the cross-session memory vault so future sessions can recall it. Use for stable facts the user stated, decisions made, or anything worth remembering beyond this session. Tags improve retrieval.

dsh-memory-vault 提供工具 memory_recall：Search the cross-session memory vault and return matching entries (facts, preferences, decisions, notes). Call this when the user references earlier work, stated preferences, or decisions that may predate this session. Entries are ordered by relevance.

dsh-memory-vault 提供工具 memory_forget：Delete entries from the cross-session memory vault by exact id, or every entry carrying a given tag. Use when the user says a stored fact is wrong, obsolete, or should not be remembered.

Cross-session memory vault for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH).

dsh-memory-vault README · dsh-memory-vault：Every DSH session starts from zero. `dsh-memory` gives your agents a persistent second brain: facts, preferences, decisions, and project notes survive across sessions and are recalled automatically.

dsh-memory-vault README · dsh-memory-vault：- **3 model tools** — `memory_remember` / `memory_recall` / `memory_forget`
- **Per-turn prompt injection** — the most recent entries are injected into every system-prompt assembly, so the agent starts each turn already aware of stored context
- **Durable storage** — records live in a [storage domain](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh_memory` unit, json backend by default; unit names are snake_case per `UNIT_NAME_RE`)
- **Browser management page** — a "记忆库 / Memory" page in Settings to browse, add, and delete entries

dsh-memory-vault README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-memory-vault
```

The `dsh.bundle` manifest wires the `dsh-memory` row into the profile automatically. To install by hand instead:

```bash
npm install dsh-memory-vault
```

then add a row to your profile `cordis.yml` (or `cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: dsh-memory
  name: dsh-memory-vault
```

dsh-memory-vault README · Usage：Tell your agent to remember things, or do it yourself:

> "记住：这个项目的部署目标是 Windows，测试命令是 `pnpm test`。"

The agent calls `memory_remember` with optional tags:

```
memory_remember(content="User prefers Windows deployment; test command is `pnpm test`", tags=["project:demo", "user"])
```

dsh-memory-vault README · Usage：When context from an earlier session matters, the agent calls `memory_recall(query="Windows deploy")` — entries are scored by tag matches (×2) and content matches, newest first. Wrong or obsolete facts are removed with `memory_forget(id="m-...")` or `memory_forget(tag="project:demo")`.

dsh-memory-vault README · Configuration：| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `injectLimit` | int | 8 | Max entries injected per system-prompt assembly |
| `recallLimit` | int | 10 | Max entries returned by `memory_recall` |

```yaml
- id: dsh-memory
  name: dsh-memory-vault
  config:
    injectLimit: 12

dsh-memory-vault README · Browser page：Settings → 记忆库 (Memory). Lists all entries newest-first with tags and timestamps; quick-add and delete buttons.

The page talks to the host half through the harness `webServer` service — same-origin JSON endpoints (`GET/POST /dsh-memory/entries`). The dynamic-plugin prototype used the sandbox-only `harness.handle`/`host.call` package RPC; the published package uses the public route so it works in any deployment.

dsh-memory-vault README · Development：The plugin is one cordis package:

- `lib/index.js` — host half: domain, tools, prompt injection, RPC handlers
- `lib/client.js` — web half: settings page
